checks.title: Prospective short-circuit levels
checks.detail: LV bus: only the transformer-limited figure is available (Transformer-limited upper bound 82.6 kA). It limits the utility contribution through one transformer and excludes generator and motor contributions, so it is NOT the LV bus fault level and NOT a design value; no rating is selected from it. NOT CALCULATED, MV bus, utility: missing short_circuit.utility_fault_level_mva, short_circuit.utility_x_r_ratio. NOT CALCULATED, LV bus, utility and one transformer: missing short_circuit.transformer_x_r_ratio, short_circuit.utility_fault_level_mva, short_circuit.utility_x_r_ratio. NOT CALCULATED, LV bus, generators: missing short_circuit.generator_subtransient_reactance_pct, short_circuit.generator_x_r_ratio. Engineering impact and the documents needed: Generator subtransient reactance x''d (short_circuit.generator_subtransient_reactance_pct): Sets the generator fault contribution. Without it the generator case is NOT CALCULATED. Source needed: Generator set data sheet: subtransient reactance x''d, X/R, rated power factor. Generator X/R ratio (short_circuit.generator_x_r_ratio): Sets the peak current from generators. Source needed: Generator set data sheet: subtransient reactance x''d, X/R, rated power factor. Transformer X/R ratio (short_circuit.transformer_x_r_ratio): Sets the peak factor on the LV side. Source needed: Transformer test report (short-circuit impedance and load losses). Utility initial short-circuit power at the MV connection (short_circuit.utility_fault_level_mva): Sets every fault level in the facility. Without it no MV or LV fault level can be calculated. Source needed: Utility written statement of maximum and minimum fault levels and X/R at the point of connection. Utility X/R ratio (short_circuit.utility_x_r_ratio): Sets the peak factor and the DC component of the fault current. Source needed: Utility written statement of maximum and minimum fault levels and X/R at the point of connection. Maximum three-phase level at the busbars, IEC 60909 method. Cable and busduct impedance between the transformer and the bus are ignored, which is conservative. Motor contribution (the mechanical plant motors) is not included. It adds to the LV level and needs motor data. Minimum fault current, needed for protection sensitivity, is not calculated. A result is NOT VERIFIED until the utility, transformer and generator data are confirmed.
checks.next_action: Supply the missing data (see the manufacturer-data register) and rerun.
